id: title:charlesvien:show what the claude cli did before a startup timeout

review.posthog_relevance: Adds CLI output metadata and helper fields to session initialization and request error results, potentially aiding diagnostics for CLI-related session failures.
review.reason: Adds CliOutputSummary interface and its fields to InitializationResult and SessionInitialization classes, including cliOutput, hasPartialLine, lastLineAt, lastMessageType, and a cliOutput() helper. P1.F4.H4 adds the cliOutput() helper; P1.F4.H5 includes cliOutput in the timeout result; P1.F4.H3 and P1.F4.H2 add tracking and assignment of cliOutput, hasPartialLine, lastLineAt, and.
review.uncertainty: The change is localized to CLI output metadata and helper fields; no broader systemic benefit or PostHog-specific operational dependency is demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the observed addition of metadata and helper fields, not on unverified outcomes or broader impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.
